attacks.name: Kukri Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.
|!wild| |*Elusive|: After this attack is resolved, this character may Advance |!range_small|.

attacks.name: Spear Thrust
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
If this character has already attacked the defender during its Activation this Turn with a |*Kukri Strike| attack, add 3 dice to this attack roll.
After this attack is resolved, if this character has Advanced or been Placed during its Activation this Turn, it may Advance |!range_medium|.

superPowers.name: Corner the Beast
superPowers.body: Choose an enemy character within |!range| 3 of this character. |<corner_the_beast>Until the end of its next Activation|, each time the chosen character Advances or Climbs, it suffers 1 |!damage|. If the chosen character has the |*Wall Crawler| |!innate| superpower, it loses the |*Wall Crawler| |!innate| superpower until the end of its next Activation.

superPowers.name: Expert Tracker
superPowers.body: Choose an enemy character. Allied characters roll 1 additional attack die when attacking the chosen character |<expert_tracker>this Round|.

superPowers.name: Elixir of Calypso
superPowers.body: This character may reroll 1 die in its attack or defense rolls.
